title: LINC: Decoupling Local Consequence Scoring from Hidden Matching in Constructive Neural Routing
abstract: arXiv:2605.06332v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Constructive neural routing solvers usually score the next action by matching a decoder context against candidate embeddings computed once per instance from static node features such as coordinates, demands, and time windows; deterministic one-step consequences such as travel, waiting, slack, and capacity changes are not provided as inputs and must be inferred implicitly by the model. We propose LINC, a decoder-side candidate decision architecture that decouples computing these consequences from learning how much they matter. The environment computes the consequences explicitly at each step; candidate-level consequences are scored by a state-conditioned shared linear comparator, while feasible-set summaries modulate the decoder context. This keeps the cached embeddings and standard global matching while giving the scoring function direct access to deterministic transition quantities. The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time

translated_title: LINC：在构造式神经路由中将局部后果评分与隐式匹配解耦
translated_abstract: 构造式神经路由求解器通常通过将解码器上下文与候选嵌入进行匹配来为下一个动作评分，而这些候选嵌入是基于静态节点特征（如坐标、需求和时间窗）在每实例中一次性计算得到并缓存的；确定性的单步后果（如行驶、等待、松弛和容量变化）并未作为输入提供，必须由模型隐式推断。我们提出LINC，这是一种解码器端的候选决策架构，它将“计算这些后果”与“学习它们的重要性”解耦。环境在每一步显式计算这些后果；候选级别的后果由状态条件化的共享线性比较器进行评分，而可行集摘要则对解码器上下文进行调制。这样既保留了缓存的嵌入和标准的全局匹配机制，又使评分函数能够直接访问确定性的转移量。带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题
tldr: LINC提出一种解码器端候选决策架构，将确定性单步后果的显式计算与重要性学习解耦，使构造式神经路由在保留缓存嵌入和全局匹配的同时，能直接基于确定性转移量对候选动作评分。
en_tdlr: LINC is a decoder-side candidate decision architecture that decouples explicit computation of deterministic one-step consequences from learning their importance, enabling constructive neural routing to score candidates directly on deterministic transition quantities while retaining cached embeddings and standard global matching.
